name: Feathermoon Stronghold (Classic)
summary: On Sardor Isle, Feathermoon Stronghold guards Feralas's western shore. General Shandris Feathermoon established it as the Alliance's main staging ground and military anchor in southern Kalimdor.

sections.title: Sentinel Bastion of the South
sections.body: Feathermoon Stronghold guards Sardor Isle, just off the Forgotten Coast. General Shandris Feathermoon built the fortress to carry Sentinel power deep into southern Kalimdor. Tyrande Whisperwind has trusted Shandris as her lieutenant for ten thousand years. The island shields the stronghold from beasts, ogres, and Horde forces crossing mainland Feralas.

sections.title: Lifeline Across the Waves
sections.body: Boats and hippogryphs link Feathermoon Stronghold to the mainland and distant Alliance hubs. A passenger boat crosses the channel between Sardor Isle and the Forgotten Coast dock. For longer journeys, a hippogryph roost connects the stronghold with Thalanaar on the Thousand Needles border, Nijel's Point in the Desolace highlands, and Auberdine in the north.

faq.q: How do you reach Feathermoon Stronghold from mainland Feralas?
faq.answer: From mainland Feralas, take the ferry from a Forgotten Coast dock across the strait, or swim the narrow channel to Sardor Isle. Alliance travelers can also fly by hippogryph after discovering the flight master.
General Shandris Feathermoon commands Feathermoon Stronghold. She leads the Sentinels and has long served High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind as a military subordinate.

faq.q: Why is the stronghold located on an island instead of the mainland?
faq.answer: Sardor Isle's isolation shields Feathermoon Stronghold from Feralas's dense threats, including aggressive wildlife, primal ruins, and hostile forces. That protection lets the Sentinels hold a secure redoubt.

faq.q: Where do flight paths from Feathermoon connect?
faq.answer: Feathermoon's hippogryph routes connect to Auberdine in Darkshore, Nijel's Point in Desolace, Thalanaar in Feralas, and Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

angles.text: For the Alliance, Feathermoon Stronghold offers a safe haven, vendor post, and staging center for operations deep in southern Kalimdor.
As a night elf, you can look to feathermoon stronghold as the southern military seat of General Shandris Feathermoon and the Sentinels, guarding the ancient wilderness.
